title: Alp config
description: Alp's config for Herdr: .herdr/alp.json (the repo's, committed), .herdr/alp.local.json (yours, in this repo, git-ignored) and ~/.config/alp/alp.json (yours, everywhere). They are deep-merged: your file, then the repo's, then your local one, the later winning. null removes a key.

runs.description: What the Run tab lists, by name.

oneOf.description: Removes a run another file defines.

inputs.description: Values a run asks for before it starts, used as ${input:id}.

command.description: A string runs in the shell; a list runs the program directly. ${workspaceFolder}, ${env:NAME}, ${userHome} and ${input:id} are filled in.

cwd.description: The folder it runs in, relative to the repo root. The root by default.

envFile.description: A dotenv file, relative to the repo root.

section.description: The heading it's listed under. "Runs" by default; Launch and Tasks come first.

dependsOn.description: Runs started first. One that isn't background must exit 0 before this starts.

order.description: How dependsOn starts. parallel by default.

background.description: Keeps running, like a dev server: runs that depend on it don't wait for it to exit.

runs.description: A group: starts each of these runs instead of a command.
